facts.text: The resort is located on a motu (islet), so boat transfers are needed to and from Bora Bora's airport and the main island.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Bora Bora Resort is located on a motu (islet) and boat transfers will be necessary from/to Bora Bora Domestic Airport or to reach Bora Bora main island (Vaitape).

facts.text: The boat transfer from Bora Bora's airport to the resort takes 20 minutes.
facts.excerpt: The transfer itself is a 20-minute boat ride.

facts.text: The resort's overwater villas are the largest in French Polynesia and the South Pacific, starting at 1,550 square feet.
facts.excerpt: Stay in the largest overwater villas in French Polynesia and the South Pacific, starting at 1,550 square feet

facts.text: The overwater villas have glass viewing panels cut into the floor to show tropical fish swimming by.
facts.excerpt: glass viewing panels throughout, cut into the floor to provide glimpses of tropical fish swimming by

facts.text: Every overwater villa has a separate living room and bedroom.
facts.excerpt: Every overwater villa is comprised of a separate living room and bedroom

facts.text: The Royal Estate is a private compound enclosed on three sides by coral walls that opens onto its own private beach facing the lagoon and Mount Otemanu.
facts.excerpt: the private compound is enclosed on three sides by coral walls and opens up to its own private beach facing a sparkling lagoon and Mount Otemanu

facts.text: The resort's private Lagoonarium is a protected underwater sanctuary for tropical fish and coral, including Napoleon fish.
facts.excerpt: Our Bora Bora hotel's private Lagoonarium is a protected underwater sanctuary for myriad species of tropical fish and coral, including the remarkable Napoleon fish.

facts.text: Snorkeling gear for the Lagoonarium is complimentary.
facts.excerpt: with complimentary snorkeling gear provided

facts.text: The spa is located on its own private island overlooking the Lagoonarium.
facts.excerpt: Relax and rejuvenate at the spa, located on its own private island overlooking the serene Lagoonarium.

facts.text: All spa bookings require a day pass.
facts.excerpt: Please note that all spa bookings require a day pass.

facts.text: Guests can choose between the Main Pool with a swim-up bar and the Oasis Adults-Only Pool with private cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Choose between the Main Pool with its lively swim-up bar or the serene Oasis Adults-Only Pool, complete with private cabanas for ultimate relaxation.

facts.text: Lagoon Restaurant is suspended over the water, has views of Mount Otemanu and showcases local produce and freshly caught seafood.
facts.excerpt: This suspended water restaurant in Bora Bora offers views of Mount Otemanu and showcases local produce and freshly caught seafood.

facts.text: Lagoon Restaurant has glass panels revealing the lagoon below.
facts.excerpt: set overwater with glass panels revealing the turquoise lagoon below

facts.text: The hotel calls Lagoon one of the finest dining experiences in Bora Bora.
facts.excerpt: The Lagoon is renowned as one of the finest dining experiences in Bora Bora

facts.text: Te Pahu hosts a Polynesian show and dinner every Wednesday night.
facts.excerpt: Join us for Polynesian Show & Dinner at Te Pahu every Wednesday night

facts.text: Breakfast can be delivered to your villa on a va'a, a traditional Polynesian canoe.
facts.excerpt: breakfast delivered on a va’a, the traditional Polynesian pirogue, to your private villa

facts.text: The 727 Bar serves tapas on a terrace looking out at the sunset over Mount Otemanu.
facts.excerpt: enjoy refined tapas on the terrace while admiring the spectacular sunset over Mount Otemanu at this beach bar in Bora Bora

facts.text: Farniente Ristorante serves Italian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Savor the flavors of Italy during your stay at Farniente Ristorante.

facts.text: Bamboo Restaurant serves Asian flavors.
facts.excerpt: Pay a visit to Bamboo Restaurant and discover the bold yet delicate flavors of Asia.

facts.text: A full in-room dining menu is available 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: a full in-room dining menu is available 24 hours a day

facts.text: Complimentary watersports at the Main Beach include stand-up paddleboarding, kayaking and local canoe.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy complimentary watersports at the Main Beach, including stand-up paddleboarding, kayaking and local canoe.

facts.text: A Cultural Ambassador leads activities such as flower crown making and pareo painting.

facts.excerpt: The Resort extends a once-a-day complimentary shuttle service to the main island and the village of Vaitape, except on Sundays and public holidays.

facts.text: Guests can explore the 17-hectare resort by bicycle.
